messages:
maria: quick heads-up — saw p50 > p95 for /v1/generate in the dashboard around 11:12-11:18 UTC yesterday. looked like a small blip but curious if this is a telemetry bug or rollout routing weirdness. anyone on routing/telemetry aware?

kevin: @maria do you have the query id or sample origin for that slice? p50>p95 usually means mixed sources or bad merge. :thinking: 

maria: i pulled the widget and the console filter was route=/v1/generate, region=us-east, timeframe=6m. sample_count showed ~1.2k but there's also a note "merged: true" in the tooltip. no query id handy.

oliver: fwiw we had a canary that moved some traffic to fallback-model-quantized for a few mins. that route gets routed to a cheaper pool and has a different sample tagging path. could be sample-origin mismatch.

jasmin: this feels like the classic "unweighted percentile merge" problem: two cohorts with different latencies merged without accounting for counts. the UI currently computes percentiles on the rolled-up histogram, not by reweighting per-origin pcts. result = p50 from one cohort > p95 from another.

kevin: can you paste the raw rollup query? oliver, any quick snippet?

oliver: here's the snippet from the rollup job:
```
SELECT route, merge_quantiles(hist) as q FROM endpoint_rollups
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND ts >= now()-6m GROUP BY route
```
We don't propagate sample_origin counts into merge step currently.

maria: so is this expected then? the product team will flag this as a correctness bug if users see p50>p95.

jasmin: it's expected for the current merge algorithm but not desirable. options:
- include sample_count provenance and show it in the UI (quick)
- change merge to weighted-percentiles (expensive, infra work)
- add UI hint: "percentiles may come from mixed cohorts; toggle to show per-origin" (nice UX compromise)

kevin: +1 to adding sample_count column and a small "per-origin" toggle. also add a warning badge when p50 > p95 detected for a slice. low effort, high signal. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary rollout to fallback-model-quantized completed at 2024-10-12T11:14:00Z (50% => 100% then rollback request queued)

oliver: i'll open an infra ticket to store sample_origin counts with rollup payloads. not a cheap change but needed for correct re-aggregation. i'll also add a quick flag on the console to default to "show origin breakdown" for now.

maria: thanks. for tracking: can we get a small doc blurb explaining why merged percentiles can invert, so PMs have an explainer? i'll draft it after oliver's infra ticket number.

jasmin: happy to help write the blurb, and i'll sketch the UI stub (toggle + warning) in figma.

kevin: filing a follow-up: add unit test for merge logic showing case where cohort A p50=100ms, cohort B p95=80ms => merged p50>p95 reproduction. we should fail the rollup job on obvious invariants while we ship the UX change.

maria: awesome — feel better about this. tagging @product for visibility. :eyes:
